Judiciary of India.fact: == Judicial hierarchy == === Courts structure === === Supreme Court === The Supreme Court is the highest court established by the Constitution.  The Constitution states that the Supreme Court is a federal court, guardian of the Constitution, and the highest court of appeal.  Articles 124 to 147 of the Constitution lay down the court's composition and jurisdiction.  Primarily, it is an appellate court that takes up appeals against judgments of the High Courts of the states and territories.  It also takes writ petitions in cases of serious human rights violations or any petition filed under Article 32, which is the right to a constitutional remedy, or if a serious case involves needs immediate resolution.  The Supreme Court comprises the Chief Justice and 33 judges.  It first sat on 26 January 1950, the day India's Constitution came into force, and thereafter delivered more than 24,000 reported judgements

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ empowers Parliament to regulate citizenship by law
Important Articles.fact: Article 11 gives Parliament the power to make laws regarding citizenship, under which the Citizenship Act 1955 was enacted.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ defines the State for the purpose of Fundamental Rights
Important Articles.fact: Article 12 defines State as including government, Parliament, state legislatures, and local authorities.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees equality before law and equal protection of laws
Important Articles.fact: Article 14 is the equality before law provision. It prohibits discrimination and ensures equal protection within the territory of India.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth
Important Articles.fact: Article 15 prohibits discrimination and allows the state to make special provisions for women, children, SCs, STs, and OBCs.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees equality of opportunity in public employment
Important Articles.fact: Article 16 provides equality of opportunity in matters of public employment and allows reservations for backward classes.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ abolished untouchability and made its practice an offense
Important Articles.fact: Article 17 abolished untouchability and forbids its practice in any form, enforced by the Untouchability (Offences) Act 1955.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees the right to freedom of speech and expression
Important Articles.fact: Article 19(1)(a) guarantees freedom of speech and expression, subject to reasonable restrictions under Article 19(2).

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees protection against conviction for ex-post-facto laws
Important Articles.fact: Article 20(1) protects against conviction for offenses that were not offenses at the time of commission.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees protection of life and personal liberty
Important Articles.fact: Article 21: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law. Interpreted to include right to education, privacy, etc.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees right to education for children aged 6-14 years
Important Articles.fact: Article 21A was inserted by the 86th Amendment Act 2002, making education a fundamental right for children aged 6-14.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees protection against arrest and detention in certain cases
Important Articles.fact: Article 22 provides protection against arbitrary arrest and preventive detention, including right to be informed of grounds of arrest.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ abolished forced labor (begar) and trafficking of human beings
Important Articles.fact: Article 23 prohibits trafficking in human beings and forced labor, with exceptions for compulsory service for public purposes.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ prohibits employment of children below 14 in factories, mines, and hazardous occupations
Important Articles.fact: Article 24 prohibits employment of children below the age of 14 years in factories, mines, or hazardous occupations.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ guarantees freedom of conscience and free profession, practice, and propagation of religion
Important Articles.fact: Article 25 guarantees freedom of religion to all persons, subject to public order, morality, and health.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ protects minority rights to establish and administer educational institutions
Important Articles.fact: Article 30 gives minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the right to constitutional remedies to enforce Fundamental Rights
Important Articles.fact: Article 32 guarantees the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights. Called the heart and soul of the Constitution by Dr. Ambedkar.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ defines the term State for Directive Principles
Important Articles.fact: Article 36 adopts the same definition of State as Article 12 for the purposes of Directive Principles.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to secure a social order for the welfare of the people
Important Articles.fact: Article 38 directs the State to promote the welfare of the people by securing a social order based on justice.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to secure right to adequate means of livelihood
Important Articles.fact: Article 39 directs the State to ensure adequate livelihood, fair distribution of resources, equal pay for equal work, and protection of children.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to provide free and compulsory education to children up to 14 (pre-86th Amendment)
Important Articles.fact: Article 45 originally directed the State to provide free and compulsory education for all children until age 14. Now replaced by Article 21A.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to promote the interests of SCs, STs, and weaker sections
Important Articles.fact: Article 46 directs the State to promote educational and economic interests of SCs, STs, and weaker sections.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to organize village panchayats
Important Articles.fact: Article 40 directs the State to take steps to organize village panchayats as units of self-government.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to secure uniform civil code for all citizens
Important Articles.fact: Article 44 directs the State to endeavor to secure a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) applicable to all citizens throughout India.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to protect the environment and wildlife
Important Articles.fact: Article 48A was inserted by the 42nd Amendment 1976, directing the State to protect and improve the environment and safeguard forests and wildlife.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to separate the judiciary from the executive
Important Articles.fact: Article 50 directs the State to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ directs the State to promote international peace and security
Important Articles.fact: Article 51 directs the State to promote international peace and security, maintain just and honorable relations with nations.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ lists the Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens
Important Articles.fact: Article 51A was inserted by the 42nd Amendment 1976. It lists 11 fundamental duties of citizens, including respecting the Constitution and national symbols.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ states that there shall be a President of India
Important Articles.fact: Article 52 provides for the office of the President of India, who is the constitutional head of the Union.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ deals with the election of the President of India
Important Articles.fact: Article 54 provides that the President is elected by an Electoral College consisting of elected members of both Houses of Parliament and state legislative assemblies.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ deals with the impeachment of the President of India
Important Articles.fact: Article 61 provides the procedure for impeachment of the President for violation of the Constitution.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ defines the Vice President as the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha
Important Articles.fact: Article 64 makes the Vice President of India the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the appointment of the Prime Minister and other Ministers
Important Articles.fact: Article 75 deals with the appointment of the Prime Minister by the President and other Ministers on the advice of the PM.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the office of the Attorney General of India
Important Articles.fact: Article 76 provides for the Attorney General of India, appointed by the President, who is the highest law officer.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)
Important Articles.fact: Article 148 provides for the CAG of India, appointed by the President, who audits the accounts of the Union and States.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the office of the Governor of states
Important Articles.fact: Article 153 provides that there shall be a Governor for each state, appointed by the President.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the appointment of the Chief Minister of a state
Important Articles.fact: Article 164 provides that the Chief Minister is appointed by the Governor and other Ministers are appointed on the advice of the CM.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the office of the Advocate General for the state
Important Articles.fact: Article 165 provides for the Advocate General for each state, appointed by the Governor.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the administration of Union Territories by the President through an Administrator
Important Articles.fact: Article 239 provides that every Union Territory is administered by the President through an Administrator appointed by him.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ defines the Gram Sabha as a body consisting of persons registered in the electoral rolls of a village
Important Articles.fact: Article 243 defines the Gram Sabha as a body of persons registered in the electoral rolls of a village within the area of a Panchayat.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for reservation of seats for SCs, STs, and women in Panchayats
Important Articles.fact: Article 243D provides for reservation of seats for SCs, STs in proportion to their population, and not less than one-third for women.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ deals with the administration of Scheduled Areas and Tribal Areas
Important Articles.fact: Article 244 provides for the administration of Scheduled Areas and Tribal Areas under the Fifth and Sixth Schedules.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for distribution of legislative powers between Union and States
Important Articles.fact: Article 246 provides for three lists — Union List, State List, and Concurrent List — for distribution of legislative powers.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ empowers Parliament to legislate on state subjects in national interest
Important Articles.fact: Article 249 allows Parliament to legislate on a State List matter if the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution by 2/3 majority declaring it necessary in national interest.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the establishment of an Inter-State Council
Important Articles.fact: Article 263 empowers the President to establish an Inter-State Council for coordination between states and the Union.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the establishment of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Important Articles.fact: Article 315 provides for Public Service Commissions for the Union and for each state.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ empowers UPSC to advise the government on recruitment matters
Important Articles.fact: Article 320 outlines the functions of UPSC including conducting examinations and advising on recruitment.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ empowers Parliament to establish administrative tribunals
Important Articles.fact: Article 323A allows Parliament to establish administrative tribunals for resolving disputes related to public services.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the establishment of the Election Commission of India
Important Articles.fact: Article 324 vests the superintendence, direction, and control of elections in the Election Commission of India.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for adult suffrage (universal adult franchise)
Important Articles.fact: Article 326 provides that elections to the Lok Sabha and state assemblies shall be based on adult suffrage, i.e., every citizen aged 18+ can vote.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the Lok Sabha
Important Articles.fact: Article 330 provides for reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the Lok Sabha in proportion to their population.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ defines Scheduled Castes
Important Articles.fact: Article 341 empowers the President to specify castes, races, or tribes as Scheduled Castes in relation to a state or UT.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ defines Scheduled Tribes
Important Articles.fact: Article 342 empowers the President to specify tribes or tribal communities as Scheduled Tribes in relation to a state or UT.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ declares Hindi in Devanagari script as the official language of the Union
Important Articles.fact: Article 343(1): Hindi in Devanagari script shall be the official language of the Union. English to continue for 15 years.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the language of the Supreme Court and High Courts
Important Articles.fact: Article 348 provides that all proceedings in the Supreme Court and High Courts shall be in English, with exceptions for Hindi in some states.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the proclamation of National Emergency
Important Articles.fact: Article 352 empowers the President to proclaim a National Emergency if the security of India is threatened by war, external aggression, or armed rebellion.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the proclamation of State Emergency (Presidents Rule)
Important Articles.fact: Article 356 empowers the President to assume control of a states administration if the state government cannot function per constitutional provisions.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for Financial Emergency
Important Articles.fact: Article 360 empowers the President to proclaim a Financial Emergency if the financial stability or credit of India is threatened.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides for the power of Parliament to amend the Constitution
Important Articles.fact: Article 368 grants Parliament the power to amend the Constitution by a special majority and, in some cases, ratification by states.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: _____ Amendment (1976) added the words Socialist, Secular, and Integrity to the Preamble
Important Articles.fact: The 42nd Amendment (1976), also called the Mini-Constitution, made extensive changes including adding Socialist, Secular, and Integrity to the Preamble.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: _____ Amendment (1972) reduced the minimum voting age from 21 to 18 years
Important Articles.fact: The 61st Amendment (1988) lowered the voting age from 21 to 18 years by amending Article 326.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: _____ Amendment (1992) granted constitutional status to Panchayati Raj institutions
Important Articles.fact: The 73rd Amendment (1992) added Part IX (Articles 243-243O) to the Constitution, granting constitutional status to Panchayats.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: _____ Amendment (1992) granted constitutional status to municipalities
Important Articles.fact: The 74th Amendment (1992) added Part IXA (Articles 243P-243ZG) providing for constitutional status to municipalities.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: _____ Amendment (2002) made the right to education a fundamental right
Important Articles.fact: The 86th Amendment (2002) inserted Article 21A making education a fundamental right for children aged 6-14.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: _____ Amendment (2003) provided for the creation of a National Judicial Appointments Commission
Important Articles.fact: The 99th Amendment (2014) was enacted to create NJAC but was struck down by the Supreme Court in 2015 as unconstitutional.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ granted special autonomous status to the state of Jammu and Kashmir (abrogated 2019)
Important Articles.fact: Article 370 granted special autonomous status to J&K. It was abrogated on 5 August 2019 by the 99th Constitutional Order.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ provides special provisions for the state of Nagaland regarding religious and social practices
Important Articles.fact: Article 371A provides special provisions for Nagaland, exempting Naga customary law and procedures from parliamentary legislation.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: The Constitution of India came into effect on _____, celebrated as Republic Day
Important Articles.fact: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950, marking the birth of the Republic of India.

Important Articles.subject: Constitution
Important Articles.question: Article _____ repeals the Indian Independence Act 1947 and the Government of India Act 1935
Important Articles.fact: Article 395 repealed the Indian Independence Act 1947 and the Government of India Act 1935, among other pre-independence laws.

A. Muhamed Mustaque.fact: Ayumantakath Muhamed Mustaque (born on 1 June 1967) is an Indian jurist currently serving as the Chief justice of the Sikkim High Court.

A. Muhamed Mustaque.subject: Constitution
A. Muhamed Mustaque.question: He has been Chairman of the Computerisation Committee of the High Court since 18 September _____
A. Muhamed Mustaque.fact: He has been Chairman of the Computerisation Committee of the High Court since 18 September 2019.

Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.subject: Constitution
